title: Way to karbala
body:
Hussain...
I remember the days
i used to see
millions going to karbala
Today i'm on this road
I'll get to see you soon
O my Maula.. O my Maula
Ya hussain, ya hussain..(6)
Ya aba abdillah..
On our way to Karbala
Hussain Maula Hussain Maula
From Najaf to Karbala
Hussain Maula Hussain Maula
On our way... Hussain
Day by Day... Hussain
To Karbala...
Hussain Maula Hussain Maula
Today that i pray for is here
All of my
dreams are coming true..(2)
Few more days and I'll be there
Maula
I am coming to you..(2)
Every Step... Hussain
Days we shed... Hussain
To Karbala...
Hussain Maula Hussain Maula
On our way to Karbala
Hussain Maula Hussain Maula
From Najaf to Karbala
Hussain Maula Hussain Maula
On our way... Hussain
Day by Day... Hussain
To Karbala...
Hussain Maula Hussain Maula
I have come from so far to Karbala
Saying,
Maula Labbaik to your call..(2)
Three days and three nights on the road
My,
feet are hurting from the walk..(2)
Day and night... Hussain
By your side... Hussain
To karbala...
Hussain Maula Hussain Maula
On our way to Karbala
Hussain Maula Hussain Maula
From Najaf to Karbala
Hussain Maula Hussain Maula
On our way... Hussain
Day by Day... Hussain
To Karbala...
Hussain Maula Hussain Maula
Yaa Aba Abdillah
You are the peace in our heart
You give comfort to our mind
O Hussain
So many people around the world
Come to
kiss your holy shrine..(2)
Far from home..Hussain
On this road.. Hussain
To Karbala...
Hussain Maula Hussain Maula
On our way to Karbala
Hussain Maula Hussain Maula
From Najaf to Karbala
Hussain Maula Hussain Maula
On our way... Hussain
Day by Day... Hussain
To Karbala...
Hussain Maula Hussain Maula
Yaa Aba Abdillah
Yaa Hussain, ya hussain..(8)
